name: A Problem about Polyline
description: There is a polyline going through points (0, 0) – ( x , x ) – (2 x , 0) – (3 x , x ) – (4 x , 0) – ... - (2 kx , 0) – (2 kx + x , x ) – ... . We know that the polyline passes through the point ( a , b ) . Find minimum positive value x such that it is true or determine that there is no such x .
input_specification: Only one line containing two positive integers a and b ( 1 ≤ a , b ≤ 10 9 ).
output_specification: Output the only line containing the answer. Your answer will be considered correct if its relative or absolute error doesn't exceed 10 - 9 . If there is no such x then output - 1 as the answer.
subsubtopic: 480. Points, Vectors, Transformations, Dot Products, Cross Products, Precision Issues and Polar Sort(2D)
